MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Smart Plug feels like a useful next purchase because it would add appliance control to the Alexa devices I already own.",
    "The external hard drive connects with my older 4TB backup drive and past data recovery purchase; more backup capacity serves a recognizable need.",
    "The larger Echo Show and Echo Auto connect with my Alexa use, though interest alone does not mean I need another display or know that the car device will work for me."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks and older Echo models repeat functions covered by my recent 4K Max, fourth-generation Dot, and second-generation Show 5. Being related to those purchases does not make them useful additions now.",
    "The internal SSD assumes a computer upgrade I have not indicated. My external backup purchases do not establish that I need or can install an internal drive.",
    "The earbuds do not connect to a current listening need evident in my purchases; using Bluetooth computer accessories does not by itself make headphones appealing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa device, including older versions of devices I recently bought.",
    "My computer accessory and storage purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in electronics, even when the recommended items serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases indicate needs I have already filled. The Show 5 stand also suggests I am equipping the display I own, rather than immediately replacing it.",
    "An addition that enables a new task is more compelling than another device that repeats an existing function.",
    "Compatibility matters before I would choose an internal drive or an Alexa device for my car, while external backup storage has a clearer connection to my past use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa and practical electronics interests, but often confuse recently satisfied needs with reasons to buy similar devices again."
}
